run_operator_benchmark: run the main benchmark suite comparing pointwise operator speedups over PyTorch aten across multiple tensor sizes
test_pointwise_add: test the nnc_add pointwise operator against torch.add for correctness and performance across broadcast and transposed cases
test_fused_addnorm: test the nnc_addnorm fused operator against eager and TorchScript addnorm implementations for forward and backward passes
test_inplace_out: test inplace and out= variants of pointwise operators to verify correctness and measure performance against aten
test_backwards_grad: test backward pass gradient correctness of pointwise operators by comparing gradients against aten reference implementation
